identity.mission: Create a billing system that feels like a modern digital extension of a traditional Indian agricultural shop—trustworthy, efficient, and culturally rooted.
principles: Fusion: Traditional Ledger Aesthetics x Modern SaaS Precision
Clarity: High contrast for readability in sunlit shops

usage.headings: Manrope (Bold/ExtraBold) - For page titles and major metrics
usage.body: Inter (Regular/Medium) - For tables, inputs, and general text
usage.shop_name: Noto Sans Telugu (Bold) - For the bilingual shop header
usage.bill_text: Inter (Mono) or Courier Prime - For the printed bill content to mimic typewriter/dot-matrix style

primary.name: Crop Growth Green
primary.usage: Primary buttons, active states, key metrics

bill_accent.name: Ledger Red
bill_accent.usage: Top border of the bill preview (traditional book binding reference)

colors.theme_strategy: Light Mode Only (High contrast for shop usage). No dark mode toggle needed for MVP.

spacing.base: Generous padding (p-6, p-8) to avoid clutter.
spacing.containers: Cards must have internal padding of p-6 minimum.
spacing.grid_gap: gap-6 for dashboard, gap-4 for dense data tables.

grids.dashboard: Mode B: Control Room Grid. Dense data but with breathing room.

bill_preview.description: A digital twin of a physical bill.
bill_preview.style: White container, shadow-xl, p-8, aspect-[1/1.414] (A4 ratio).
bill_preview.header: Centered Shop Name in Telugu (Large) and English. Address below.
bill_preview.table: Classic grid with borders. Columns: Sr, Particulars, Batch, Exp, Qty, Rate, Amount.

stock_cards.style: Flat border card with color-coded left strip (Green=Good, Red=Low, Yellow=Expiring).

auth_screen.style: Split layout. Left: Image (Green Fields). Right: Clean form.
auth_screen.image_overlay: Green gradient overlay on the image for text readability.

auth_background.alt: Lush green agriculture field with mountains

stock_placeholder.usage: Default image for products without photos

visual_enhancers.textures: Use a subtle 'noise' texture on the sidebar background to give it a tactile, paper-like feel.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft, diffuse shadows (shadow-lg) for the Bill Preview to make it 'float' above the desk.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders in neutral-200 for tables. No floating rows.

anti_slop: Do NOT use default Shadcn slate colors everywhere. Tint them with green.
Do NOT center the entire app. Use a sidebar layout.
Do NOT use gradients for text.
accessibility: Ensure high contrast for the 'Total Amount' display.
All inputs must have clear labels (no placeholder-only inputs).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Install 'lucide-react' for icons. 2. Use 'date-fns' for date formatting in the bill. 3. Create a 'BillTemplate' component that accepts data and renders the printable view. 4. Use 'react-to-print' for the printing functionality.
